name: coauth-DBLP
description: Nodes represent authors. Each hyperedge represents a publication and contains the set of co-authors of that publication. This is a temporal higher-order network dataset, where each hyperedge is a publication recorded on DBLP. Timestamps are the year of publication.

hypergraph_metadata.name: (STRING) Dataset name (e.g., coauth-DBLP).
hypergraph_metadata.weighted: (BOOL) Whether the hypergraph is weighted (e.g., true).

nodes_metadata.author: (STRING) Name of the DBLP author represented by the node (e.g., E. F. Codd).

edges_metadata.time: (INT) Normalized publication year used by the temporal hypergraph (e.g., 38).
edges_metadata.weight: (INT) Number of publications collapsed into this author-set/year hyperedge (e.g., 5).
